title: Mindanao theater group performance at Asean Summit wows India's Modi

blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY – The Mindanao-based Integrated Performing Arts Guild (IPAG) wowed Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi through a cultural performance following his arrival at the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit in Manila. Steven Patrick Fernandez, IPAG founder and artistic director, told the Inquirer through Viber that Modi approached the company on stage and exchanged warm handshakes and greetings. READ: Asean, India seek stronger economic and regional cooperation “As he moved from artist to artist, he repeatedly uttered ‘Excellent!’” Fernandez said.
